evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-14"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-14". POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. Dates are plain YYYY-MM-DD.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 {"dueDate":"2026-12-01"} returned 200 and the todo showed the new date. PATCH /todos/1 {"dueDate":null} returned 200 with dueDate null. Re-setting a date afterwards worked.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30", "15.10.2026" and the number 20261015 each returned 400. PATCH with "2026-02-30" returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-10-15 (UTC). I created five todos: past due 10-14, future due 10-16, due today 10-15, no due date, and one done with a past due date 2026-01-01. GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the first one (the one due 10-14), with overdue true. The todos due tomorrow or today, without a due date, and done (marked done via PATCH) were not returned.
evidence.AC5: The page at / showed "Fällig: <date>" for each todo that has a due date (2026-10-14, 2026-10-16, 2026-10-15, 2026-12-01, 2026-01-01).
evidence.AC6: In the page snapshot only the "past" todo (due 2026-10-14, not done) had a strong element with the text "überfällig". The future, today, no-date-then-later-dated and done todos had no such marker.
evidence.AC7: The page had a checkbox labelled "nur überfällige". After I clicked it, the list showed only the "past" todo, marked überfällig.
